name: Masoretic Text
notes: The textual tradition the default chronology derives from. Its Genesis 5 and 11 ages differ from the Septuagint's.

name: King James Version (1769 Blayney edition)
citation: The Holy Bible, Authorised Version, 1769 Blayney edition, as published in the npm package bible-kjv@1.1.3 (sha512-pl6dXVYFxd7vlkGE6kiNmd0GUFe5UPyJzu8KwkY3vEbjO4v470Lh5+lAH61UiZMru5oevN7aZzDCSudb2frzaA==)
license: Public domain in the United States; Crown letters patent in the United Kingdom, which is why it corroborates rather than leads
notes: The corroborating source. An independent translation of the same Masoretic Hebrew, so its agreeing with the World English Bible on a number is worth more than either alone. A figure is promoted to VERIFIED only when both state it.

name: American Standard Version (1901)
notes: Listed as an available public-domain cross-check. Not used by the Phase 2 verification pass, which uses the World English Bible and the King James Version.

name: World English Bible (eBible.org)
citation: World English Bible, eBible.org, as published in the npm package world-english-bible@1.0.1 (sha512-OH/5yt9BYrhy1oBXXwhSuL9ES97t5Ij8rLWeQZUOIFAkoGzZaq8aLcKMBdzwHqPbJBkyMYPhgFj6rzvtT/oT4A==)
notes: The project's authoritative source for verifying chronological figures, chosen because it is public domain everywhere and translates the Masoretic Hebrew. No verse text from it is committed to this repository: it is a devDependency read at verification time by scripts/verify-source.ts, which records only the numbers a verse states and a short quoted fragment as evidence.

name: Acts 7:4 harmonisation of Abraham's birth
notes: Terah died at 205; Abraham was 75 at the departure from Haran; Acts 7:4 places that departure after Terah's death. 205 - 75 = 130. The basis of the default chronology's Terah-to-Abraham birth offset.

name: Genesis 11:26 read as Abraham's birth year
notes: Reads Terah's age of 70 as Abraham's birth offset. The verse gives one age for three sons and does not state that Abram was the eldest, so this is an interpretation. Basis of the alternate chronology only; never VERIFIED as an explicit statement.
